A [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] '''scouting vessel''', one of the first [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessels]] built by the Duros [[Species/Legends|species]], was launched well before the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[25,053 BBY]], at a [[Time/Legends|time]] when the Duros were still using an [[Duros dialect|ancient dialect]] that had faded away by the time the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] joined the Republic. The ship's [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]] contained records of the first [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorations, and the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] on the planet [[Akana]]. However, a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] containing the ship's [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] was found thousands of years later during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and the datapad's discovery led to the discovery of the crashed ship itself on Akana.<ref name="Mission" />
